body:
People face the oldest fear and quietly get back the power it was holding.

Someone has the dreaded conversation, opens the avoided document, names the memory, and finds it survivable; capacity comes back online without ceremony.

With Pluto trine Chiron, people release what was locked up and confirm in the same motion that the injury no longer needs its guard.

No crisis had to force any of it.

The change may be invisible to everyone else, but the people who did the facing notice decisions coming easier, and that ease tends to be the evidence.
